exitCodeEvidence: The original wrapper only entered its failing identity assertion inside the code === 0 branch after waiting for npm run build. TypeScript and Vite completed normally; the enclosing verification wrapper then exited 1.
elapsedUnavailableReason: The wrapper stopped at its post-build fingerprint assertion before writing its elapsed-time receipt. No total build duration is reconstructed.

sourceVerified.algorithm: The same sourceFiles traversal and full-string Array.sort ordering as vite.config.ts; path + NUL + bytes + NUL SHA-256.

identityVerification.initialFailure: AssertionError comparing emitted fingerprint to the verification helper digest.
identityVerification.cause: Python pathlib.Path ordering compares path components, unlike JavaScript full-path string sorting. No source difference was found.
identityVerification.correction: Recompute with the exact Node/Vite ordering and independently compare every input against its committed Git blob.

outputLocationOnly: Normal pinned-LOD prebuild, TypeScript and Vite production build; only generated output and temporary/cache storage were relocated.
